subsequent_shared_workspace_focused_chec.scope: Manager/general runtime, persistence, extensibility, agents and model adapter; before later concurrent Damage Accountant coverage edits.

interpretation_notes: Every attempted report and case is retained, including failures and non-boolean outcomes.

Historical evaluator v1 recorded status/substrings rather than every semantic outcome; strict evaluator v2 is identified per report. In particular unavailable and correction scenarios require its stronger checks.
Live runs use the real configured Manager model with synthetic registered specialist methods; they do not establish successful live PM2.5 retrieval.
Scripted decisions use the same runtime validation/dispatch path but are not real-model quality evidence.
Model calls are charged dispatch attempts, including failed and unknown outcomes, not guaranteed provider completions.
Token totals use actual captured provider receipts. Null means unavailable or not applicable; no zero-cost provider inference is implied.
Supervised live round 1 has two timeout cases without final observations; captured calls/tokens are lower bounds.
Raw reports retain actual decisions, inspected evidence, output text, full receipts and events.
The direct-only initial smoke used an earlier case-file hash and is not a matched full-suite comparison.

Read-only post-timeout durable observations recover three otherwise omitted actual model receipts separately from the original report observations; historical outcomes and raw reports remain unchanged.
